items.headline: $WLFI Craters 39% in Sudden One-Hour Selloff
items.summary: Trump-linked World Liberty's $WLFI plunged ~25% in a single hour on Coinbase and OKX, extending losses to 39% as Bitcoin slipped just 2%. Traders are watching for the next move.

items.headline: $FLUID Halts $5.5B Market After Mythos AI Review
items.summary: $FLUID paused its $5.5B trading market following a review by Mythos AI, sparking fresh security concerns across DeFi. Details on the trigger are still emerging.

items.headline: $CHZ Tells Holders: Bridge Out Before Dec 1
items.summary: Chiliz is urging users to move funds off Chiliz Chain before ChainPort shuts down, naming Arbitrum, BNB Chain and Avalanche as destinations. Withdrawals can't be guaranteed after Dec. 1.

items.headline: $SKY Boosts Staker Rewards, Cuts Vault Debt Caps
items.summary: Sky's new settings allocate more $SKY to stakers while trimming vault debt limits, effective Nov. 23. A separate 25M USDS debt-repayment proposal is still pending.

items.headline: $SFP Maker SafePal Widens August Breach Disclosure
items.summary: SafePal, maker of $SFP's ecosystem wallet, expanded its August breach disclosure to older orders and warned of fake firmware-update emails targeting affected buyers.
